evidence: Verg. Ecl. 8.80: haec ut cēra liquēscit

phrases.latin: «Liquēscetne illa nix, tata?» «In summīs montibus nē aestāte quidem liquēscit.»
phrases.english: “Will that snow melt, Dad?” “On the highest mountains it doesn’t melt even in summer.”
phrases.source: Libellus VI, Reditus: per Alpēs domum
